reviews.comment: I really liked him! Acct 229 is a hard class, but he explains the concepts very well. He is truly so personable; so easy to approach. He even invites us to his Thanksgiving if we don't have anyone to celebrate with. You definitely have to be on top of studying for the exams. Acct is a lot of work and if you do not put in time, it'll show.
You get what you put into this class. If you study a lot and put in the effort you will get the results you desire. This class is tough but it is not impossible to get an A.

This class is HARD. And it is well known all around campus lol. You must do a lot of outside work to be able to truly understand the work and be able to do well on tests. The tests are hand written by Wolfe and Knoop and VERY VERY DIFFICULT to prepare for.

Wolfe is an incredible prof! I would still say Knoop is first choice, but he is a for sure second. He is a PPA grad in his late 20s. He explains everything and speaks slowly and well during lectures. He is so approachable and really cares about the success of his students; I've never felt scared raising my hand in class. He's AWESOME
Wesley Wolfe was a great acct 229 professor!!! Take him for the class!!!! He is very easy to talk to and he genuinely wants you to succeed!! He gives a lot of partial credit which is awesome!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Wolfe was awesome for 229. If you feel like you need guidance, talk to him, he is always willing to help out. He is a nice guy who wants the best for his students.

That said, take Knoop if you can, not only is she incredible, she also writes the tests.


One gripe is that he's left handed, so he covers his work on the doc cam as he's writing.
Amazing professor, really went out of his way to help students. The class is challenging but Professor Wolfe makes it less of a burden. If you cannot register for Knoop, take Wolfe.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Awesome Prof. Learned a lot. Willing to help struggling students

Professor Wolfe was amazing! He gives really good lectures, you just have to pay attention in class. The class is hard and you have to study a lot. Take good notes and do all the quizzes and practice problems available. The grade heavily relies on the exams. There is 400 points from 4 exams and 100 points from the quizzes and group project.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Had Professor Wolfe for 229 this Fall and had a great experience. The class is hard but he prepared us well for the challenge. He is very responsive to his email and will help you out if you are willing to put the work in.
Such a good professor and a great class overall! There was no busy work which was nice. The lectures were very clear. There are fill-in-the-blank notes for lectures which were very helpful.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took Wesley Wolfe last spring for ACCT 229. He is an amazing professor who truly loves teaching accounting. If you need help outside of class, he is always willing to help. He also makes personal connections with every student. This class will still be the hardest class you take, but he gives you all the resources to succeed. Take him if you can!
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Wolfe was so incredibly sweet! Literally one of the nicest professors I have ever had. ACCT 229 is just a hard class in general.. There are 4 exams, weekly quizzes, and 1 group project. the exams are worth 400 of the 500 points so there's really nothing to bring up your grade. If you cannot get Knoop, take him. Although, Knoop writes the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Wolfe is honestly the GOAT so far in my TAMU career.  He was a super helpful teacher that genuinely cares about students and tries to help them succeed.  I took him when it was just his second semester of teacher and you can just tell he loves what he does.  If you can I would take him just because he's such a chill and cool guy.

One of my favorite professors I've ever had at TAMU! You can tell he genuinely cares for his students and fosters meaningful relationships with them outside the classroom. Great feedback & so so helpful (especially if you go to office hours)! Although the class is challenging, he makes it doable! PLS TAKE HIM even if it's an 8 a.m.!!!!

I very much dislike accounting, but I very much loved Prof. Wolfe. His explanations made more sense to me than any other accounting profs, and he is such a kind-hearted person as well. He is my favorite professor I've ever had, and I wish him the best.

He's a dedicated professor who genuinely wants his students to succeed. He provides textbook problems, quizzes, summary videos for each topic, and more. To do well in this class, consistently practicing the problems is essential.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor! He was always available to meet outside class times for questions and help. Super approachable and genuine! I recommend Wolfe to anyone taking 229. He made the concepts easier to understand despite it being a pretty challenging course.

Professor Wesley Wolfe is fantastic! Accounting 229 seemed intimidating, but he made complex concepts easy to understand. As long as you stay engaged, you'll do well. His patience, humility, and ability to make class engaging set him apart. If you're choosing a professor, Wolfe is the best choice!

The class is very difficult, so if you must take it I highly recommend taking it with him. Lectures are as entertaining as an accounting lecture can get. Ready and willing to help students learn and is all around a genuine, chill guy.
Took him last semester for accounting 229 and as his first semester teaching he did really well. He is a young professor and very relatable and makes you want to do well in his class.

It was a hard class, but he genuinely made me want to learn more. You will have to go to class to pass but attendance is not mandatory. He is committed to your education and does his best to explain things in the easiest way possible. The review videos are a MUST before the exams. Overall, very good professor!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very impressive teaching as it was his first semester when I took his class. He is very caring, and will take time outside of class to help you with any questions you may have. He also teaches the course at a good pace, opening questions up to the class throughout his lectures.

Wes was a phenomenal professor, especially for his first year. He was committed to helping his students learn and made himself readily available to anyone who was willing to put in the work to succeed. If there was something he didn't know, he found the answer and was overall an excellent first-year professor! Highly recommend.

Great professor all around especially for his first year! This class is really hard and requires a lot of studying but he's very willing to help prepare for exams. There's a lot of material that also helps study for exams. He's very caring and attentive towards his students, I would take him again if I could.

This semester was Wes's first semester teaching and he was so chill. He very knowledgeable, caring, and understanding. Your grade in this class depends on how much you're willing to put in. I would email him at night and still get responses within like an hour. He's super approachable and a great professor.
